mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_idempotency_record (user_id, endpoint, idempotency_key, request_hash, response_code, response_json, status, expires_at, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{endpoint}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestHash}, #{responseCode}, #{responseJson, typeHandler=com.group4.kaoyan.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_idempotency_record SET status = #{status}, response_code = #{code}, response_json = #{body, typeHandler=com.group4.kaoyan.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
